name: PNETInstantLaunchpad

methods.name: initialize
methods.desc: Fund base/PNET MBR and a small safety cushion once.

methods.name: budget
methods.desc: Side-effect-free call whose only purpose is adding opcode budget to a group that needs it.

methods.name: launch_start
methods.desc: Create the immutable ASA and escrow PNET bought with exactly one ALGO, in one call.

methods.name: launch_finish
methods.desc:
Seed Tinyman, burn 80% of the LP, record the 10%/10% split and optionally grant Vestige access.
The Tinyman pool must already exist: its bootstrap pair may be earlier transactions of the same group. The LP asset id is read from the pool's Tinyman state, so the caller never has to know it in advance.

methods.name: claim_creator_lp
methods.desc: Pay the launcher's recorded 10% LP once. The opt-in directly before the call is a zero self-transfer.

methods.name: cancel_launch
methods.desc: Resolve an escrowed launch after the immutable cancellation delay.

methods.name: release_cancelled_pnet
methods.desc: Release deferred cancellation PNET only to the hardcoded platform wallet.

methods.name: grant_vestige_access
methods.desc: Retry path when launch_finish ran without the Vestige grant.

methods.name: release_platform_allocation
methods.desc: Release only a recorded platform allocation (cancelled ASA or platform LP) under hardcoded authority.

desc: Immutable Tinyman-backed PNET launch escrow and public directory.
